value.rationale: Determines a sharp finite-size phase transition and its full distribution for a natural multi-string LCS problem, addressing a regime inaccessible to fixed-sample normalized LCS asymptotics. Pairwise avoidance rigidity drives asymptotic independence of all 2^r pattern-missing counts, a stronger structural law than an expected-length bound.
